integrity: One stated infinite-family theorem with exact proof, standalone rational finite checks and documented literature comparisons. Universal claims do not rely on finite experiments.
scientific_limitations: Only strictly positive one-way cyclic rates; endpoint positivity, not stage or nonlinear positivity. The initial resolvent/Cayley identity and general RK theory are prior; unindexed equivalent directed-cycle classifications remain possible.
title: Sharp theta-method positivity and rate-majorization on directed cycles
